after.raw_text:
CabinZero Classic 36L Cabin Backpack. The Classic 36L is a simple, ultra-light cabin bag. It weighs 760 g and measures 44 x 30 x 24 cm. Made from 600D polyester with YKK zippers, a wide-opening compartment, an internal zipped mesh pocket, and a 10-year warranty. Price: $79.95.

Features a ventilated mesh back panel for airflow and an extra-thick memory foam shoulder strap system, lab-tested to eliminate pressure pain over 6 continuous hours of wear.
